source: The Knot Real Weddings Study for 2024 weddings: an average cost in the region of $33,000 with about 115 guests, and an average engagement ring in the region of $5,200 (The Knot Jewelry and Engagement Study). Split here into a per-guest part (catering, bar, rentals, favours) and a fixed part (venue, photography, music, attire, flowers, officiant) so a guest count moves the total.
confidenceNote: Recalled national averages, rounded, and the per-guest / fixed split is a convention chosen here: the study reports totals, not that split. Costs vary several-fold by region and by what the couple wants. Every figure is editable on the page.
note: Read by engines/wedding.js (D-217). Cents. guests × perGuestCents + fixedCents + ringCents is the default total. tableSize is how many an extra table seats.
